reason: Operationalize the remaining predeclared HOLDOUT falsifications before any HOLDOUT access.

delayed_feature_placebo.rule: For every challenger-only feature column, replace its HOLDOUT value with the last same-token observable value at or before t-300 seconds; keep frozen baseline columns current. Rows without causal lag support are excluded from this placebo only.
delayed_feature_placebo.model: Use the already-frozen challenger scaler/model without refitting.

block_time_shift_placebo.rule: Replace challenger-only feature columns with the last same-token observable value at or before t-1800 seconds. No circular wrap is used; unsupported leading rows are excluded.
block_time_shift_placebo.model: Use the already-frozen challenger scaler/model without refitting.

sign_inversion.applies_when: Frozen selected feature name contains 'ofi' or 'imbalance'.
sign_inversion.rule: Multiply challenger-only signed feature columns containing 'ofi' or 'imbalance' by -1 and evaluate the frozen challenger model. No refit.

high_activity_removal.rule: Within each coordinate's HOLDOUT evaluation rows, count rows per market and remove markets with count >= the empirical 90th percentile. This threshold uses support only, never outcomes.

source_version.rule: Where source_version is carried by the frozen panel, report observation count and baseline-minus-challenger loss improvement separately by source_version.

continuity.rule: All primary labels already require the same reconstructed continuity segment. Report zero cross-segment primary labels as an invariant; do not manufacture gap-spanning targets.

alternate_freshness.rule: Where raw_capture_bin_age_s exists, separately report evidence restricted to raw_capture_bin_age_s <= 300 seconds. Where unavailable, report unsupported rather than proxying another field.

depth_matched_null.applies_when: Dataset is depth and depth_2c is available on the evaluation row universe.
depth_matched_null.rule: Bin depth_2c into event-local deciles using feature values only, then deterministically permute challenger-only columns within event x depth-decile using the frozen candidate seed. Evaluate the frozen challenger model without refitting.

inference_role: All are falsification/sensitivity diagnostics. Primary HOLDOUT evidence remains the unchanged baseline-vs-selected challenger comparison on the frozen complete-case row universe.
